Edge case: GPU rendering at 120fps with LPDDR5X-8533 — sustained memory bandwidth measured at 65 GB/s (close to theoretical peak of 68.3 GB/s). Frame pacing jitters by +/- 2ms.

Is this jitter caused by GPU shader stalls, or by LPDDR5X self-refresh exits during inter-frame gaps? How do you isolate GPU-side vs DRAM-side jitter using Perfetto + memory bus probes? What sysfs knob tunes the self-refresh entry threshold to avoid entering self-refresh during 120fps gaps (if the gap is shorter than self-refresh entry latency)?
